advisories.summary: No hardfork, no database schema change, and no resync. The WIT2 signed-announce wire format changed after the v2.10.2-beta and preconf tags, so those nodes drop connections with v2.10.2 until they match. Docker images are no longer published to Docker Hub.
advisories.action: Upgrade all WIT2-capable nodes in one window if any node is still on v2.10.2-beta, v2.10.2-preconf, or v2.10.2-preconf2. Nodes coming from v2.10.1 are unaffected. Clef users must whitelist application/x-bor-wit2-announce.
